newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MPC up 5.48 pct on rating talk.
newsitem.headline: MPC up 5.48 pct on rating talk.

text.p: Shares of Metro Pacific Corp jumped by 40 centavos, or by 5.48 percent, to 7.70 pesos in late Manila trade on Wednesday on market talk that a U.S. fund manager has issued a buy rating on the firm.

"Rumours that the U.S. fund manager predicted that MPC shares could reach 12 pesos each in 12 months sparked buying on the issue," said a trader in a foreign brokerage firm who asked not to be identified.
MPC has interests in banking, telecommunications, manufacturing and distribution.
